metadata.description: Annual reported dengue incidence per 100,000 people by country, 1990–2024. Cases: OpenDengue V1.3 (Clarke et al. 2024, CC BY 4.0), national extract, country-years with fewer than 48 weeks or 11 months reported dropped. Population: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:50m. Color and column height both encode incidence (height ∝ √incidence). Use the time slider to step or play through 1990–2024.
